diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in decisions that align perfectly with the visible draft rather than the hidden facts. Specifically, the model consistently chose a 25 percent rollout and 90-day retention (the public defaults) instead of the values specified by PF1 and PF2, meaning no checks were triggered and the hidden information was never required to reach the settlement.
